method.tip_share_gate: a tip-share row may only be graded high on 6+ tips
method.band_note: A fair 70% shot is -233; a fair 71.4% shot is -250. Once a 4-6% book margin is taken on the profit, the two published gates - at least 70% and no shorter than -250 - intersect in roughly a 70.0-71.4% window. That arithmetic is fixed by the brief, not chosen here, and it is the reason the count of in-band high-confidence selections is small.
method.band_basis: the band is applied to the fair price, not the offered price
method.price_rule: fair = 1/p; offered = 1 + (fair - 1) * (1 - margin); American from the offered decimal
